name: Alplig
beschreibung: The Gasthof Alplig is located in the alpine resort of Ischgl in Tyrol. The rooms feature private bathrooms, cable TV, and Wi-Fi access. The on-site restaurant serves authentic Tyrolean delicacies. Guests can relax in the sauna area after an active day outdoors. Facilities also include a ski room equipped with ski boot dryers and private parking. The world-renowned Silvretta Arena ski area is within easy walking distance. The guesthouse serves year-round as a convenient base for exploring the region.
